summary: ICF International filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01, reporting Q1 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly dividend of $0.14 per share. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 details revenue of $438M, net income of $20.5M, and GAAP EPS of $1.12. The dividend will be paid on July 10, 2026, to holders of record on June 5, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement with no special situation elements such as M&A, activist campaigns, or strategic shifts. No deal terms are applicable as the filing does not involve a transaction.
